tool_input.message:
All 5 review findings on docs/spec-audit-durability.tex are fixed, committed as a271f02.

1. Model faithfulness (Design 1): WorktreeRemoveD1 was Xi (a no-op query) and never modeled the removal, so writerExists=zfalse was unreachable in D1 alone. Replaced with a faithful Delta (writerExists' = zfalse, spooled/sealed/committed/lostUnwarned unchanged). Counts changed: Design 1 full exploration went from 9 states/42 transitions to 17 states/74 transitions (writerExists can now genuinely flip, doubling reachable combinations). Re-confirmed with a fresh goal search: lostUnwarned=ztrue is still unreachable in D1 — conclusion unchanged, now on a faithful model. Also fixed the adjacent wording: neither CommitAnywhereD1 nor WorktreeRemoveD1 "could" set lostUnwarned by their own definitions; they're now described as the two operations that changed relative to the current design.

2. Prose-vs-code: corrected the ReadChunkVerified description — it does a strict decode, an empty check, and a last-line-timestamp-vs-filename check (internal/audit/read.go:88-105), not a hash check. SHA-256 only appears in quarantine/tombstone naming.

3. Citation: corrected all three purgeOneTombstoned citations from store.go:534-627 to 534-697 (verified the function's actual closing brace at line 697), since the old range excluded both the unsealed-lines guard (634-669) and the flagged-tombstone write (671-677) that SessionPurgeForce depends on.

4. Record: dropped the stale round-1 goal-search count (7/35) from the counterexample section's prose; the Tool Run table and its own caveat already carry the current number, and the count was never the load-bearing fact there — the trace is.

5. Wording: "the four reachability rows" corrected to "three" (Design 1 correctly has no goal-search row).

Verification: fuzz check clean, pdflatex -halt-on-error compiles to a 15-page PDF with exit 0 (only cosmetic overfull-hbox warnings from a wide table column), full ProB re-verification on the committed file (17 states/78 transitions, deadlock-free, unchanged since the current design's own schemas weren't touched) and on all three scratch variants, make check green. Only docs/spec-audit-durability.tex was touched. Stopping here.
